fact: The term 'artificial intelligence' was coined in 1956 at Dartmouth.
Machine learning trains algorithms on data rather than explicit rules.
Neural networks are inspired by the structure of the human brain.
AI can diagnose certain diseases with accuracy matching expert radiologists.
Natural language processing powers chatbots and virtual assistants.
Computer vision enables self-driving cars to detect pedestrians.
Generative AI can create text, images, music, and video from prompts.
Reinforcement learning agents master games by trial and error.
AI systems are used to detect fraud in real-time financial transactions.
Large language models contain billions of trainable parameters.
